checks_run.actual: Applied 9 migrations; the second migrate was a no-op. Views actor_display, business_unit_closure and scope_node exist, and mth_app has SELECT only. Probe SUMMARY pass=49 fail=0. draft->closed, active->closed and on_hold->closed are all refused with 422 urn:mth:problem:invalid-transition: 'Closure requires the G6 (Sustain) business approval with validated benefits, which is not available in this release'. The worker exited 0 on SIGTERM, and the API was still ready afterwards. api.log has 0 error/fatal lines.

The live refusal cites G6 and validated benefits (B0014 'Benefits before closure'). #0078FF is flagged provisional:true in tokens.json.

summary: Round 3 is a clean re-gate after a test-only change (F-DG1-232, apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts). I found no regression. The candidate ID and file count match. Typecheck, build, lint, unit tests on Node 22 and 24 (326/326), contrast, no-cdn, OpenAPI, integration (209/209), the full e2e suite in EN and AR (18/18) and a 30x repeat of the shell journey all pass. The live probe gives 49/0: closure is refused with 422 citing product gate G6, scoped access holds, and the DB cycle guard rejects. The rendered AR-RTL and EN-LTR screens keep the provisional wordmark, use bundled fonts and make no foreign requests. I raised no new findings. My round-2 findings F-DG1-001/002/003 remain CLOSED_VERIFIED, as the assignment states. deps:verify was not run (it needs network access and is outside this assignment).
